AEGIS IDENTITY CLOUD — DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM (DPA)
Version 4.2 — Effective 2025-09-01
Retrieved 2026-02-03T09:16:10Z

1. DEFINITIONS
"Customer Data" means data submitted to the Services by or on behalf of Customer.
"Subprocessor" means a third party engaged by Aegis to process Customer Data.

2. PROCESSING
2.1 Aegis processes Customer Data only on documented instructions from Customer.
2.2 Aegis maintains a public list of Subprocessors and provides 30 days' notice of additions.

3. SECURITY
3.1 Aegis maintains administrative, physical, and technical safeguards aligned to ISO/IEC 27001:2022.
3.2 Aegis notifies Customer of a Personal Data Breach without undue delay and no later than 72 hours
    after confirmation.

4. HEALTHCARE
4.1 Where Customer is a Covered Entity or Business Associate under HIPAA, the Aegis Business Associate
    Agreement is incorporated by reference and controls with respect to Protected Health Information.
4.2 The BAA applies to the Services and to Subprocessors identified as BAA-covered on the Subprocessor page.

5. ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FEATURES
5.1 Certain Services include AI-assisted features ("AI Features"). AI Features process Customer Data to
    generate suggestions for Customer's administrators.
5.2 Aegis does not use Customer Data to train foundation models made available to other customers.
5.3 AI Features are provided on an "as-is" basis with respect to output accuracy. Aegis does not warrant
    the accuracy of AI-generated suggestions and publishes no error-rate or accuracy metrics.
5.4 Customer is responsible for reviewing AI-generated suggestions prior to acting on them.

6. AUDIT
6.1 Aegis makes SOC 2 Type II reports available annually under NDA.

7. RETURN AND DELETION
7.1 Aegis deletes Customer Data within 90 days of termination.
